actions.description: Inspect rollout dirs, services, and listening ports
actions.command: id; echo "---"; ls -la /opt/rollout/ 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -la /var/lib/rollout/ 2>&1; echo "---"; systemctl list-units --type=service --all 2>&1 | grep -i rollout; echo "---"; ss -ltnp 2>&1 | head -50
